assign.now: clustering computed styles of clickable elements across 14 pages

log.msg: crawled 14 pages (home, framework, ui, Dropdown, Panel, drawer, tabs, editor, gallery, audit, web/nav/tabs, toc, files, blog) at 1280x900. clickables sampled == rows in button-rows.json: 305. Clustered by (padding, radius, background, border, font-size, weight, transform): 27 distinct raw CSS signatures. Most are state variants of the same family (e.g. 4 of the 27 are .tab in active/inactive/hover on one page) — collapsing those, ~9 real visual button FAMILIES: plain nav/text link (0 padding, no bg), page-preview card link (white bg, radius), dev-bar icon button (bordered, subtle bg), sidebar-link, demo-btn CTA (uppercase, bordered, bold — the closest thing to a real '.btn'), tab underline link, blog chip (pill, radius:999px), mode-btn (bordered square), page-column-item. No single dominant '.btn' class — 'demo-btn' and site '.btn'/theme button rules coexist as separate lineages.

panel/menu computed-style crawl: 21 rows, 3 clusters — but this undercounts badly, because dropdowns/menus/drawers render CLOSED by default (0-size, excluded). Passive crawl is not the right instrument for these; switched to driving them open directly for the real comparison (see drive-log).

assign.now: driving each control into a second state, crop-shooting; keyboard spot-checks

log.msg: drove + shot 7 controls into default+driven states: Dropdown (closed/open, popover top-layer), Panel (workspace + always-open properties rail), drawer (closed/open/dragged-wider via grip, 304px to 380px, real 1:1 drag), tabs (OVERVIEW to DOCS click-switch), mode toggle (auto to light icon swap), editor (drag-block workspace: palette/tree/properties), files (tree + selected-row highlight + source panel). 9 shots landed in public/imagine/design/controls/shots/.

KEYBOARD spot-check, 5 controls, Tab/Enter/Escape driven headless: (1) Dropdown trigger — Tab reaches it (outline:auto, visible), Escape closes the popover. PASS. (2) drawer close-x — Tab focuses it, Enter fires close() (--drawer class cleared). PASS. (3) mode toggle — click AND Enter both flip color-scheme (auto/light/dark). PASS. (4) tabs — Enter on a focused .tab DOES activate it (class swaps to 'tab active') but outline:none — it works with NO visible focus ring, a real a11y gap. PARTIAL. (5) Panel toolbar button (.panel-btn, e.g. 'tune'/'zoom_in') — real <button>, tabIndex 0 in markup, but .focus() silently no-ops (activeElement never moves) because the toolbar is hover-revealed and hidden by default. Keyboard users cannot reach it at all. FAIL. Tally: 3 PASS, 1 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL.
